overlay-bubs: Create bubs as a child of baseboard-trogdor To see what's here, you can try these things: echo "Simple way of making bubs from trogdor" git rm -r overlay-trogdor git commit -m "remove trogdor" git revert --no-edit HEAD git diff HEAD~ > bubs_from_trogdor.patch sed -i~ 's/trogdor/bubs/g' bubs_from_trogdor.patch sed -i~ 's/baseboard-bubs/baseboard-trogdor/g' bubs_from_trogdor.patch sed -i~ 's/Trogdor/Bubs/g' bubs_from_trogdor.patch sed -i~ 's/TROGDOR/BUBS/g' bubs_from_trogdor.patch echo "What we actually have" git rm -r overlay-bubs git commit -m "remove bubs" git revert --no-edit HEAD git diff HEAD~ > bubs_actual.patch echo "The diffs" diff bubs_from_trogdor.patch bubs_actual.patch When you do that, you see the only real diffs are: < +++ b/overlay-bubs/chromeos-base/chromeos-bsp-bubs/chromeos-bsp-bubs-0.0.1-r2.ebuild --- > +++ b/overlay-bubs/chromeos-base/chromeos-bsp-bubs/chromeos-bsp-bubs-0.0.1-r1.ebuild --- < + doappid "{9023C063-08D6-4A4F-908C-BCF97DE8BA69}" "REFERENCE" --- > + doappid "{2AB7AC10-90E7-4E03-9A54-359EE2CC08BB}" "REFERENCE" --- < + ec: "bubs" --- < +# All firmwares to build from the EC code base < +EC_FIRMWARE="bubs" --- > +# Magic sauce for mocktpm (override baseboard-trogdor) > +USE="${USE} tpm -tpm2 mocktpm" > + > +# No Cr50 (override baseboard-trogdor) > +USE="${USE} -cr50_onboard" > + > +# No EC (override baseboard-trogdor) > +USE="${USE} -cros_ec -eclog" > + > +# We're not unibuild (even though baseboard-trogdor is) > +USE="${USE} -unibuild" ...plus all the chromeos-config stuff is gone. Explanations for the above: - We don't need an r2 on the first ebuild. - We want a different appid. uuidgen | tr [a-f] [A-F] - We don't have an EC. - We don't have Cr50 and so we want mocktpm - We're not unibuild BUG=b:138390427 TEST=setup_board --board=bubs Cq-Depend: chromium:1719220 Change-Id: Idb3084e270bde12900c471a651896efa6f1cf02d Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1719388 Tested-by: Douglas Anderson <dianders@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Douglas Anderson <dianders@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Philip Chen <philipchen@chromium.org>

dlcservice: Modify install API to take protobuf list of DLC ids The previous API for install took a single DLC id for the install. Now the API for install will take a list of DLC ids. Changes to the |InstallResult| and |DlcModuleInfo| are for |DlcModuleList| to be leveraged by the |OnStatusUpdateSignal()| as well. These changes will not break backwards compatability as code is not in production use. No users would be affected. A future work to do here is to handle scenarios where not all DLC modules may successfully be installed. cros-kernel2.eclass: On new kernels make sure we install gdb scripts As of upstream linux commit 67274c083438 ("scripts/gdb: delay generation of gdb constants.py") in kernel 5.1 gdb scripts aren't generated unless we make the 'all' target. We don't ever make the 'all' target. See CL:1650151 for one example of why. Let's manually add "gdb_scripts" to the targets if the kgdb USE flag is enabled and we detect that the gdb_scripts target is present. BUG=None TEST=Compile various kernels and see gdb scripts when expected.
